diagnostics: Original software adapter selection chose GL: depth textureLoad unsupported by GLSL translation. An isolated process disables EGL provider selection and uses pinned software Vulkan; no driver files changed. Both command/log sets retained.
Predictor probe initially used adjacent subnormal coordinates at zero; WGSL may flush these. Final oracle uses +/-1e-6 metres around zero and adjacent representable floats elsewhere.

Coherent experimental unit binary retained initial-hint-zero probe; the proposed arbitrary-hint edit was not in that binary and is not claimed as verified. All proposed algorithms are rejected; shipping oracle tests the original function.
No other intentional GPU workload or shader build during release ABBA; compiler jobs run before or after those measurements. Desktop load and unmanaged power/clocks remain possible noise.

acceptance.numerical: Exposure scaling, finite HDR and unchanged opacity checked; existing integral envelopes only for stated fixtures
acceptance.performance: No accepted lookup optimization; no coastal/planet/full-frame speedup claim
